newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber boosted by Japans's rise.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber boosted by Japans's rise.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were generally stable in late trading on Monday, while market sentiment firmed up following gains in Tokyo, traders said.
Traders said September SIR20 prices were offered at 43.50-44.00 cents/lb fob Medan, 43.50 fob Palembang and Padang, 43.75 cents fob Surabaya and 43.25 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
The Tokyo market got a boost from the rise of the U.S. dollar against the yen, prompting investors to cover their shorts, traders said.
Traders said the Tokyo gains helped boost the otherwise weak market sentiment following volatile regional currencies.
Some European firms were seen checking prices at current levels for SIR20, one Jakarta dealer said, with deals likely to be done later today. -- Jakarta newsroom + 6221 384-6364
